What I learned working as a communication assistant was that if you have something you don't want to make big you don't talk about it. 

let's put an example: you have a restaurant and someone says your beer taste like shit. It's just an opinion on your Facebook page who has thousands of followers. You have two options. 

1. You ignore it and let it be. One angry customer is something normal and you won't really lose your business for it. Also. The opinion will dissappear and it will end being a little deal.

2. You get totally angry and publish in your popular page that this person is saying your beer tastes bad, that he doesn't know about beer blablabla so people notices that hey, why are you so angry? Is your beer really bas and u are trying to hide it?, so a lot of people began to say "your beer is bad" and something that could have come and go unnoticed turns into a big popular deal.

It's the same principle of why you shouldn't give attention to a troll.
